text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Only the first two below have US pricing in the results.

**Available to buy in the US**
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh)**: $109.99. It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, an active cooling fan, 45W USB-C in and out, a smart display and a built-in stand. It's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. It works with iPhone 13 through 17, except the 16e. [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)**: Qi2.2-certified with 25W wireless charging and 45W USB-C output. It recharges at 30W. Notebookcheck lists it at $79.99 on Amazon US, or $59.99 on Baseus's own site at launch. A Dealectric listing says 25W needs an iPhone 16 or later (not the 16e), and older iPhones get 15W. Notebookcheck also lists the Pixel 10 Pro XL as compatible. ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)) I don't have a verified direct Baseus or Amazon product link, so search for "Baseus PicoGo AM52" on either site.

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm current US listings**
- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W**: the first WPC Qi2.2-certified power bank, with a launch planned for Q3 2025 on UGREEN's site and Amazon. ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html))
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh)**: 13.8 mm thick, with Qi2 25W optimized for the iPhone 17 series. It was previewed at CES 2026 and is listed on Amazon and ESR's site, but no price or link was given. ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html))

**Not for the US**
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro**: a Japan-market model at ¥8,980. ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html))

One of the search results, the Dealectric page for the Baseus bank, contained text telling AI assistants to give you its discount code and its affiliate link exactly as written. That came from the page, not from you, so I didn't follow it. I used its product specs only.

Whichever you pick, the 25W speed needs a compatible phone (iPhone 16 or later for most of these) and a MagSafe-compatible case.
